2026_05_BUF_LA.headline: Buffalo’s coverage problems confront Stafford’s receiving duo
2026_05_BUF_LA.paragraph1: Buffalo must repair a pass defense that struggled against Drake Maye before facing Matthew Stafford, Puka Nacua and Davante Adams in Los Angeles. The Rams have moved the ball effectively but undermined drives with turnovers and special-teams mistakes, offering Josh Allen opportunities to steal possessions. Allen has also committed recent giveaways, making ball security consequential on both sides. The tactical contest is whether Buffalo can disrupt Stafford before his receivers uncover, or whether the Rams can force Allen into a high-risk comeback script.
2026_05_BUF_LA.model_rationale: Los Angeles can create favorable passing matchups, but its own mistakes leave Buffalo opportunities. Protection, turnovers and coverage discipline are more consequential than either offense’s reputation.
